title: Crispy Schnitzel with Citrus Aioli
description: A classic German dish with a twist, crispy schnitzel paired with a tangy citrus aioli.
instructions: Prepare the breading station: in one shallow dish, mix flour, salt, and pepper. In another, beat eggs. In a third, place panko breadcrumbs.
Season pork cutlets with salt and pepper. Dredge cutlets in flour, shaking off excess.
Dip floured cutlets in eggs, making sure they're fully coated.
Roll egg-coated cutlets in panko breadcrumbs, pressing gently to adhere.
Heat about 1/2 inch of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add 2-3 breaded cutlets to the skillet and fry until golden brown and crispy, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Transfer fried cutlets to a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
To make citrus aioli, mix lemon juice and mayonnaise in a small bowl. Add garlic powder and mix until well combined.
Serve crispy schnitzel with citrus aioli on the side.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley or chives, if desired.
